fields.title: Keep SQL Server and PostgreSQL implementations separate within a project
fields.decision: Do not support combining the PostgreSQL and SQL Server implementations in one project; a model targets one provider.
fields.context: The Mapper must know which provider will execute created parameters and would otherwise encounter attributes for multiple providers; provider delegates would also have to be separated.

alternatives.option: Enable both provider implementations in one project.
alternatives.whyRejected: The documented review found the added Mapper ambiguity and delegate complexity exceed the potential value.

fields.consequences: Provider-specific behavior remains explicit and simpler; applications needing multiple providers must separate that work rather than mix providers in one project.
